Designed by Charlene Lam
BACKGROUND

People buy cupcakes for all types of celebrations, making them one of the most popular baked goods in the US. Most grocery stores and bakeries carry cupcakes year-round, packaging them in injection molded plastic carriers that keep the cupcakes secure during transport.
RESEARCH
I conducted several interviews which revealed two main pain points
1. It is difficult to get cupcakes out of their packaged compartments. The frosting gets messy on your fingers and it is unsanitary for sharing.
2. Adults tend to buy cupcakes more often when their children are young for birthdays and classroom celebrations
Common grocery store cupcake packaging
Cupcake packaing with finger holes that still cause difficulty
PROCESS
Step 1: The die line is created in illustrator, printed card stock, and cut out with a Cricut.
Step 2: A crease board is used to pre-stretch paper fibers then folded in indicated directions.
mountain fold
valley fold
Step 3 : Internal compartments are constructed.
(Section view of cupcake compartments)
a. Structure is folded into a square wave pattern
b. Cupcake indents are pushed out
c. Center structure is folded and glued
d. Easy-expand tabs connected
e. Structure is completed
Step 4 : Plastic panel is glued.
Step 5: Packaging is ready to be filled with cupcakes!
RESULTS
1. The carriers are expandable for easy use.
2. Animal graphics added for kids' celebration.
Customer receives cupcakes.
Easy-expand tabs are released on both sides.
Side flaps are opened to release the outer walls.
Packaging is open flat with easy access to the cupcake.

/assets/55147f_8d521b8dd80349cf975bdd3a1: CAD - Each panel was modeled as a sheet metal component in OnShape, and the patterns were laser cut onto acrylic sheets.

Fixtures - A custom heat-forming fixture was designed to shape the large exterior curves. This fixture was 3D printed with PPA-CF given its high temperature resistance. Once cooled, the panels retained their desired shape.

Heat Forming Process - The acrylic sheets were clamped down over the fixtures guided by the alignment features for for accurate bend placement. A heat gun was then used to evenly and slowly heat the acrylic sheets over the fixtures.
Surface Finish - After the acrylic was heat formed, they were finished with spray paints with the desired color, material, and finish
